metadata.description: Cursor plugin/skill marketplace for RazorMetrics: curated, approved plugins for use across the team.

plugins.name: aws-core
plugins.description: Build, deploy, and operate applications on AWS: IaC (CDK, CloudFormation), core services (Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions, ECS/Fargate, IAM, Bedrock), databases, observability, messaging/streaming, SDKs, and cost optimization.

plugins.name: aws-agents
plugins.description: Build, deploy, and operate AI agents on AWS with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore (Strands, LangGraph), Gateway/MCP tools, multi-agent orchestration, memory, evaluation, observability, and production hardening.

plugins.name: aws-data-analytics
plugins.description: Data lake, analytics, and ETL workflows with S3 Tables, AWS Glue, and Athena, plus vector storage and semantic search on Amazon S3 Vectors.

plugins.name: aws-agents-for-devsecops
plugins.description: Investigate incidents, review code and run UAT for release readiness, scan code for vulnerabilities, and run penetration tests with AWS DevOps Agent and AWS Security Agent.

plugins.name: atlassian
plugins.description: Atlassian plugin for Cursor with MCP (Rovo v2) and skills for Jira, Confluence, triage, backlogs, sprint dashboards, and status reports.
